note: Independently reread RFC9494 Section 4.2: 'If the timer for the Long-Lived Stale Time for a given AFI/SAFI expires before the session is re-established, the helper MUST delete all stale routes of that AFI/SAFI from the neighbor that it is retaining.' Preserve the settled pre-reestablishment judgment after rereading all three tagged functions and their actual registered RIB consumer. TestLLSTTimerExpiry_SingleFamily observes the expired IPv4 family with IPv6 still retained; TestRFC9494LLSTExpiryDeletesTheFamilysStaleRoutes exercises production wireStateCallbacks and requires the specific IPv4 purge command while forbidding the unexpired IPv6 purge. TestRFC9494DelayedDownPreservesLLSTDeadlines supplies the decisive actual-storage assertions on JSON and structured DOWN: both-live, one-expired, both-expired and zero-GR cases; one retained level-2 route with literal LLGR_STALE and active retention before each original deadline, including one nanosecond before; actual absence and cleared family retention at expiry; peer release at the last deadline. newGRWithRealRIB invokes the registered bgp-rib engine and real execute-command RPC, not a deletion mock. The current callback routes to the explicitly registered purgeStaleCommand. Its replacement deletion boundary selects StaleLevel>Fresh and removes entries under PeerRIB's storage lock, the same lock as inserts, collecting only successfully removed native identity, received ADD-PATH presence/value and message generation. Sent cleanup selects those removed owners, not old projections merely absent from a newer received table, captures the sent receipt, dispatches after unlocking, and reaches the command/batch/final expected-owner consumer. The final writer rejects obsolete receipts. This preserves the clause while avoiding withdrawal of a newer received owner. The four physical80 runs and omitted/reset controls remain retained evidence, not substitutes for this clause mapping and not proof of synchronization, consecutive-restart, other LLGR gaps, or universal destination-FIB behavior. Native handleTimerExpired halts bind reachability only.
